subject: CONTROL clause
notes: The shape arm (kb/Work PB177 arm C) rejects an operand subject to any OCCURS clause, recognised with DataItem.IsTable so both dynamic-capacity shapes are covered. kb/Work PB205 added the WRITTEN half: a subscript on the operand was dropped at capture, and since SR3 bars the OCCURS case and 8.4.2.3.3 SR2 bars a subscript on an item without one, no subscripted control operand is legal - it is now rejected on the spelling, not only on the item.
